sections.title: Story
sections.description: A curated subset of lore videos is now watchable directly in the game. Be sure to check back when new lore beats are added!

sections.title: Spirit Showdown
sections.description:
From November 11-24, spirits decide your fate in the Arcade! Swap heroes when eliminating enemies or after dying two times.

As you complete challenges, you'll earn exclusive free Spirit-themed rewards!

sections.title: Junkrat's Loot Hunt
sections.description: Junkrat's Loot Hunt is back again, running from November 20-23! Earn lootboxes by completing challenges that unlock as you play!

sections.title: General Updates
sections.description:
Player Progression

- Retired badges and sub-badges are accessible in the game again. Career Profile → Progression → Legacy.
- Overwatch 1 player level has also been moved to the Legacy screen.

Player Cards

- In Role Queue modes, instead of showing highest leveled heroes across the hero roster, player cards now show your highest leveled heroes in the role you are playing.
- Non-Role Queue modes will continue to show highest leveled heroes across the entire roster.

Advanced Info Panel

- Added the "Jump Cancel" keyword to abilities that can be ended early for bonus movement.

heroes.dev_note: With Hazard’s block now less reliable against burst damage, this change increases his mobility, allowing him to reposition and engage more effectively.

Alongside Hazard’s updates, these adjustments address specific interactions that were previously mitigated by these defensive abilities, such as Mauga’s Ignited critical damage and Reinhardt’s Earthshatter.

general.text_en: Fortify and Terra Surge now only prevent headshot critical damage and not forced crits

heroes.dev_note: Previous changes led to a healthier overall playstyle for Ramattra, but he could feel too fragile in certain matchups. Increasing his base health improves survivability in both forms.

general.text_en: No longer has half effectiveness while in Annihilation

heroes.dev_note: Wrecking Ball can be extremely difficult to punish due to his high health pool and mobility, especially without strong crowd control. Reducing his base armor lowers overall survivability while rewarding effective Adaptive Shield usage.
Increasing Ashe’s falloff range allows her to perform more consistently at her intended mid- to long-range distances.

general.text_en: Secondary Fire falloff range rescaled from 30–50 meters to 40–60 meters

heroes.dev_note: Flashbang’s short hinder duration could feel difficult to capitalize on. This slight increase gives Cassidy players a more reliable window to follow up when landing a Flashbang.

general.text_en: Hinder duration increased from 0.9 to 1.2 seconds

heroes.dev_note: Echo can struggle to safely position within her effective range. Increasing her aerial acceleration during Flight gives her more control when engaging or escaping.

general.text_en: Movement acceleration in air increased by 100% when changing directions while Flight is active.

heroes.dev_note: This damage increase ensures Mei’s Primary Fire remains the consistent choice in close-range duels.

general.text_en: Damage per second increased from 100 to 110

heroes.dev_note: These adjustments make Disruptor Shot easier to land and more reliable without increasing its travel distance.

general.text_en: Damage per second increased from 80 to 90
Maximum travel duration reduced from 1 to 0.75 seconds

heroes.dev_note: Healthy Hacker has struggled to provide consistent value as a result of its short active window. These adjustments extend its effectiveness and offer more opportunities to benefit from the perk, even when combat occurs away from health packs.

general.text_en: Stealth duration on successful hack increased from 2 to 3 seconds
Time before overhealth degeneration increased from 6 to 10 seconds
general.subject: health

general.text_en: Packs can now be picked up at full overhealth to reset the degeneration timer
general.subject: health

heroes.dev_note: Brigitte’s healing output can sometimes feel limited compared to other supports. Reducing Repair Pack’s cooldown provides more consistent healing across all situations.
This partial reversion to Juno’s previous air strafing makes her movement more responsive without making her overly evasive to fight against.

general.text_en: Movement acceleration in air increased by 50% when changing directions while Glide Boost active.

heroes.dev_note: Kiriko’s Ultimate remains one of the most powerful in the game because of its large area and the value it provides to her team. Increasing its cost brings its time to earn more in line with its impact.

Lifeweaver’s larger model made him much easier to hit than most supports. With his lower health pool, this hitbox reduction offsets that loss in survivability, while weapon swap improvements make his gameplay smoother and more responsive.

general.text_en: Model and hit volume size reduced by 8%
Automatic reload time for the inactive weapon reduced from 2.5 seconds to 2 seconds
general.metric: automatic reload time for the inactive weapon

general.text_en: Time between weapon swap reduced from 0.25 seconds to 0.125 seconds

sections.title: 6v6 Hero Changes
sections.dev: Most changes made to 5v5 are reflected in 6v6 unless otherwise noted. This patch aims to maintain consistent balance between the two modes while addressing outliers, particularly among tanks. Heroes that currently feel strongest or weakest in 6v6 have been adjusted to ensure a more balanced experience.

general.text_en: Overhealth gained per target reduced from 35 to 25 HP.
general.subject: health

general.text_en: Amount of damage to gain Empowered Punch increased from 100 to 120.
general.metric: amount of damage to gain empowered punch

general.text_en: Self-healing from wounds damage scalar increased from 1.5x to 1.75x.
Overhealth gained per target reduced from 75 to 50.
general.subject: health

general.text_en: Now has a cooldown per target.

blocks.title: General Stadium Changes
blocks.body:
- Drafts have been updated to use blind pick system. This means that both players on each time pick at the same time and their hero is revealed together.
- Draft mode now automatically assigns tanks to the 5th slot.
- Players are now able to unequip powers on the same round they are equipped.
- Powers are locked at the end of the Armory timer.
- HP bars are now displayed for your team in Stadium matches.
- The hero stat section in the Armory has been updated to sort by your highest stat increases.
- Detailed tooltips for each row in the Armory hero stat section have been added.
- Impacted abilities and weapons are displayed in these tooltips.
- Interact on any tooltip to access the full details screen.

blocks.title: Stadium Combat Text Changes
blocks.body:
- Weapon Power and Ability Power are now displayed as two separate floating numbers. This feature can be adjusted from Settings.
- A new setting has been added to adjust the lifetime of floating text.
- A new setting has been added to display self-healing. This setting is defaulted to off.
- We are now dynamically adjusting the height at which floating text is displayed to improve visibility for heroes in melee range.
- Overkill and overhealing values are now displayed when eliminating an enemy or healing a friendly target.
- Kill cameras will now display stadium combat text.
- Improved the stability of stadium combat text on moving targets so it’s less distracting.

heroes.dev_note: Hazard’s wall-focused powers were hitting a little too hard, dishing out big burst damage on top of strong zoning potential. We’ve reduced the knockback damage for both Off The Wall and Fortress to make the ability feel fairer to play against while keeping its area control and impact intact.

A few hero items were lagging behind in overall value and flexibility, so we’re giving them some extra polish. Enhanced Target Sensors and Oladele-copter Blades now offer more meaningful offensive boosts, Efi’s Theorem gains defensive utility to help sustain in fights, and HollaGram Helmet gets a price cut to make it easier for Orisa to support the team if they need unstoppable.

raw_text: Enhanced Target Sensors - Rare Weapon Hero Item
Oladele-copter Blades- Epic Ability Hero Item
Efi's Theorem - Epic Ability Hero Item
HollaGram Helmet - Epic Survival Hero Item

heroes.dev_note: These changes are aimed at adding more build variety for Freja and making her weaker options more viable choices. We're also reducing the vertical burst of her Weapon Power build, and adding an additional lever for us to have more fine tune control for further adjustments if needed.

lines_en: Spread of additional bolts reduced by 60%.
Additional bolts fire every 3rd shot (Down from every 5th shot).
Max Life per hit increased to 8% (Up from 5%).
Added: "Take Aim Bolt Explosion damage reduces Updraft Cooldown by 1s".
raw_text: Windwalker Boots - Rare Ability Hero Item

lines_en: Added: Restore 10% Max Ammo every 1s while momentum is slowed by Take Aim.
raw_text: Aeroweave Cloak - Rare Survival Hero Item

lines_en: Added: 25% reduced explosion damage from extra Take Aim Bolt.

heroes.dev_note: Sojourn’s Disruptor Shot build was too costly for the payoff it provided, making it hard to justify in most matches. We’ve reduced the build’s overall expense and improved her defensive options through Power Slide buffs, giving her more flexibility to reposition and stay in the fight longer.

raw_text: Liao's Logistics Data - Epic Ability Hero Item
Energy Leech - Rare Ability Hero Item

heroes.dev_note: Junkrat's Ability Power builds have struggled to find their footing compared to his Weapon Power builds, so we're adding more power and consistency to both his Concussion Mine and Trap centric builds for increased build variety.

lines_en: Concussion Mine damage upon landing after detonating Concussion Mine on yourself increased to 20% reduced effectiveness (Up from 30% reduced effectiveness).
Removed Arming time to spawn Mini Steel Trap.
Max Number of Mini Steel Traps increased to 5 (Up from 2).
Added: "Detonating Concussion Mine on yourself reduces Concussion Mine cooldown by 15%".
raw_text: Jamison's Jumpers - Epic Ability Hero Item

lines_en: Max Life Overhealth increased to 8% (Up from 5%).
raw_text: Refreshing Radiation - Epic Survival Hero Item
Lithium Alloy - Epic Ability Hero Item

lines_en: Steel Trap Health increased to 100% (Up from 50%).
raw_text: Rat Pack - Rare Ability Hero Item

lines_en: Ultimate Charge gain now triggers on all Ability damage (Instead of just Total Mayhem damage).
raw_text: Charged Chompas - Epic Ability Hero Item
Spiked Gloves - Rare Weapon Hero Item
Thermal Trap - Rare Survival Hero Item

heroes.dev_note: Bringing back the extra heal that Medicinal Missiles used to have. This boost adds more sustain for allies and makes her supportive playstyle feel even more rewarding when landing those precise shots.

lines_en: Now heals extra 30 health on pulsar hit.

heroes.dev_note: Brigitte's Weapon Power build has remained niche and difficult to justify over her other build options. We're adding a bit more firepower and survivability here to make it a more viable option in the right situation.

lines_en: Bonus Damage on 360 Rocket Flail swing increased to 125% (Up from 100%).
Healing on next Rocket Flail swing increased to 125% of damage dealt (Up from 100%).

blocks.title: General Fixes
blocks.body:
- Fixed an issue with Wuyang and Illari that caused incorrect Healing and Resource rates to be applied when affected by Attack Speed increases.
- Fixed an issue where the Headhunter perk ignored headshot damage reduction from Bob's Tank passive.
- Fixed an issue where Reinhardt's Charge did not pull Wrecking Ball out of Roll mode.
- Fixed an issue where Mei's Deep Freeze perk could potentially freeze enemies twice within a short timeframe.
- Fixed an issue where characters affected by Ana's Groggy were still slowed after using an ability that should have cleansed the Groggy effect.
- Fixed an issue where Sojourn's charge was lost after a primary fire when using the Overcharged perk.
- Fixed an issue where the timer for Mercy's resurrect was not shown in ping messages.
- Fixed several minor color and formatting issues in Advanced Info Panel text.

blocks.title: Stadium Fixes
blocks.body:
- Fixed an issue where Kiriko's clone could inadvertently stop the payload from moving due to too many friendly players on the objective.
- Fixed an issue where the Salvaged Slug item interrupted Winston's primary fire to reload the granted ammo.
- Fixed an issue where Reaper's aim was not accurate immediately after using Shadow Step.
- Fixed an issue where the size of the mini Steel Trap from Junkrat's "Trap II, Esquire" power was not accurate relative to its trigger timing.
- Fixed an issue where Hazard's Downpour ability did not gain benefits from life steal bonuses.
- Fixed an issue where Torbjorn's Clocked Power gave the benefit to all allied heroes instead of just Torbjorn.
